profile.name: Dipta Saha
profile.bio: I build web platforms, mobile apps and Python AI systems that are fast, maintainable, and easy to use: e-commerce, ERP, dashboards, community apps and computer vision. I work across Next.js, ASP.NET, Node.js and Flutter, and I've shipped multi-vendor e-commerce platforms, a custom ERP, real-time dashboards and apps on the Play Store and App Store. I also build Python projects in computer vision and NLP, from YOLO detection systems deployed with FastAPI and Docker to fine-tuned BERT models.

highlights: Build and maintain scalable web and mobile applications.
Implement RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services.
Work with cross-functional teams to deliver quality software.
Optimize performance and apply security best practices.
Explore AI and machine learning for upcoming projects.
Developed scalable e-commerce platforms with advanced SEO features.
Built a custom ERP system that automated key processes across departments.
Created real-time dashboards for five projects to track metrics.
Led development of an internal event management system.
Built RESTful APIs in Node.js for internal and client-facing apps.
